title: finding(pm-dispatch): after #17285, default-tier lanes have no named "review of record" — five `Clause-②: yes` merges in one window carry none, and clearing the carrier is indistinguishable from never reviewing
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #18 segment 6, `session_017Js5kTpTtxieBjPyScgxJ3`, `huangyiirene`) from the duty-one leak sweep over merges since 2026-09-09T14:45Z (leak-class rows only; all the rest carried a head-pinned verdict or a card-side PASS). ⛔ Not a triage grading — labels are the filer's proposal.

## What the sweep found

#17285's tier notice (03:1xZ) says, for non-spec / non-skills lanes: 「The lane seat's own default-tier review, plus the gates (widening tells, pin tests, `dispatch-gates --tier`), is the review of record」. Five `Clause-②: yes` merges in the window carry **no review of record at all** — the only "review-like" comment on the PR or its card is the dev's own `os-dev-report`:

| PR | merged | by | carrier | review of record |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| objectstack#17181 (card #15951) | 2026-09-10T00:03Z (before the notice) | os-steve | never hung | none — PR body reasons `yes` in prose, no line-start declaration, no card-side verdict |
| objectui#8921 (card #8900) | 03:11Z | os-zhuang | hung, cleared | none |
| objectui#8922 (no card) | 03:15Z | os-zhuang | hung, cleared | none |
| objectui#8926 (card #8897) | 03:15Z | os-zhuang | hung, cleared | none |
| objectui#8931 (card #8268) | 03:28Z | os-zhuang | hung, cleared | none |

Also in the window, three objectui PRs (#8891, #8886, #8873) were merged **unchanged at the head a director-seat REWORK verdict named**, after the notice, with no seat review recorded either; their measured published-face residue is carried by objectui#8936 / #8937 / #8938 (not incidents under the new policy — recorded here only as the shape the gap takes).

## The gap in the rule text

Under the old text, `needs:contract-review` was the machine carrier for "a tier verdict is owed" and the leak sweep could read PASS-on-head from the PR/card. Under #17285 the lane's default-tier review is the record, but **nothing names where it lives or what it must contain**, so:
- clearing the carrier is indistinguishable from never reviewing (the five rows above);
- `check-clause2-carriers --pair` still reads only the declaration; no gate reads "a review of record exists on this head";
- the director's after-the-fact audit (director.md 职责一) has nothing to audit against.

## Ask (skills seat)
1. In `contract-review.md` (or the lane files), name the review of record for default-tier lanes: one comment on the PR (or card) on the merged head, with the checklist's ①②③ (derived judgments / semver / boundary flags) and `Implemented-by:` / `Reviewed-by:` — the same shape the tier verdict already has, minus the tier.
2. Make clearing `needs:contract-review` require citing that comment (provenance), so the sweep can read it.
3. Decide whether the five merges above get a post-merge reading now (the director's audit can supply it on request) or are recorded as accepted under the transition.

**Provenance:** sweep = `leak4.py` over `/pulls?state=closed&sort=updated` filtered by `merged_at ≥ 2026-09-09T14:45Z`, verdict regex on PR + card comments; the full table is in the segment-6 brief on #12708.
